title: Facebook Watch is expanding globally and giving publishers one stat to track how many people watch their videos week after week
text: Facebook Watch is expanding globally and giving publishers one stat to track how many people watch their videos week after week Wednesday, 29 August 2018 () ** · *Facebook is expanding Watch globally and letting international publishers earn money from their videos, starting with the UK, Ireland , New Zealand and Australia .* · *Publishers are also getting their hands on a new metric called user retention, which tracks how many viewers watch a publisher’s videos week after ... ▶ Facebook Rolls Out Watch Video Service Internationally 00:35 On Wednesday Reuters reported that Facebook is rolling out its Watch video service globally one year after it launched in the United States, to compete with platforms like Alphabet Inc’s YouTube. Facebook’s Head of Video Fidji Simo said Watch was gaining real momentum in a crowded marketplace...
